name: zip_code
description: ZIP the demand estimate covers. Part of the grain. Present for all 15 ZIPs, including the 9 with no store.

name: week_start_date
description: Monday that opens the ISO week. Part of the grain.

name: category_spend_usd
description: Total coffee-category spend by ALL businesses in the ZIP that week, USD. Whole-market, not this brand: the third-party panel series a retailer buys. Divide historical_sales revenue by this to recover a store's capture rate.

name: transaction_count
description: Coffee-category transactions across all businesses in the ZIP that week.
